Trigger An adjacent enemy misses the gamekeeper with melee attack

Effect The gamekeeper attempts to capture the flailing assailant. They attempt an Athletics check to [[/act grapple]] the attacker.
actions.name: Play Chicken
actions.trigger: An adjacent enemy misses the gamekeeper with melee attack

actions.description: The orc gamekeeper makes a Strike against a creature adjacent to one of the gamekeeper's animal allies. If it hits, the animal ally deals one die of damage to the target, using the highest damage die among its unarmed attacks.
actions.name: Animal Tandem

actions.description: When the gamekeeper rolls a success to [[/act command-an-animal]], they get a critical success instead; if they roll a critical failure, they get a failure instead.
actions.name: Insistent Command

name: Orc Gamekeeper
publicNotes:
Gamekeepers live on the outskirts of the hold, usually remaining solitary and tending to animals they've captured. Every part of a trapped animal can be useful for making supplies or trading.

Orcs have a strict moral code encompassing valor and accomplishment, and they cast out those unwilling to follow it. For the last few generations, orcs have been trying to erase the narratives around their culture as being solely focused on war and violence. They invite other races and adventuring parties inside their holds so they may experience the truth of who the orcs are.
